title: State bird.
bodyText: The nene (Branta sandwicensis), also known as the Hawaiian goose, is established and designated as the official bird of the State.
bodyHtml: [§5-17]  State bird.  The nene (Branta sandwicensis), also known as the Hawaiian goose, is established and designated as the official bird of the State. [L 1988, c 178, §1]
